lens: A landmark cross-border REIT combination led the tape: Prologis and SEGRO agreed an ~$18.8B recommended deal that put six covered banks on a single transaction — even as Williams struck an up-to-$5.5B midstream acquisition, Prysmian agreed to buy Atkore for ~$3.8B, and The Hartford picked up Equitable’s employee-benefits book, all against a sharp rebound in advisory stocks.

stories.headline: Six covered banks work Prologis’ ~$18.8B recommended combination with UK logistics REIT SEGRO
stories.why_it_matters: Prologis (NYSE: PLD) reached agreement on a recommended all-share combination with SEGRO plc, valuing SEGRO at ~£14.0B (~$18.8B) — 0.0920 new Prologis shares per SEGRO share plus an optional partial-cash alternative up to £3.51B, a 39–49.8% premium to pre-offer prices, targeted to close 1H 2027. The Rule 2.7 announcement names Rothschild, J.P. Morgan and Eastdil Secured as joint lead financial advisers to Prologis, with BofA Securities and Citigroup as additional advisers; Evercore and Morgan Stanley as joint lead advisers to SEGRO, with UBS and Goldman Sachs also advising. A cross-border public-company REIT combination runs UK Takeover Code, antitrust and shareholder-documentation workstreams over a long path to close.
stories.suggested_action: This deal touches six covered banks — open with JPMorgan/BofA/Citi (Prologis) or Evercore/Morgan Stanley/UBS/Goldman (SEGRO). A cross-border REIT combination under the UK Takeover Code runs months of regulated diligence a secure room organizes.

deal_clock.event: Prologis discloses possible combination with SEGRO

stories.headline: BofA leads Williams’ up-to-$5.5B acquisition of Momentum Midstream; Barclays and Jefferies advise the seller
stories.why_it_matters: The Williams Companies (NYSE: WMB) agreed to acquire Momentum Midstream / M6 Midstream from EnCap Flatrock for up to $5.5B (~$3.5B cash and debt plus ~$2.0B in Williams equity), announced alongside Q2 results and subject to HSR clearance. The release names BofA Securities as lead financial adviser to Williams (with Truist), and Barclays and Jefferies as exclusive financial advisers to M6 (sell-side). A large gas-gathering acquisition runs antitrust, asset-integrity and confirmatory diligence across a sizeable midstream complex.
stories.suggested_action: Engage BofA (Williams buy-side) and Barclays / Jefferies (M6 sell-side) — a ~$5.5B midstream acquisition runs HSR and asset-level diligence a secure room keeps organized.

deal_clock.event: Williams agrees to acquire Momentum/M6 Midstream (up to $5.5B)

deal_clock.event: Prysmian agrees to acquire Atkore at $95/share (~$3.8B)

stories.headline: Markets extend the August rally — Nasdaq +1.5%, Dow +1.1% — and advisory stocks surge: GS +2.8%, JPM +1.8%, LAZ +2.0%
stories.why_it_matters: US equities extended their August advance: S&P 500 +0.9% (~7,669), Nasdaq +1.5% (~26,309), Dow +1.1% (~53,769), with the 10Y Treasury easing to ~4.64% and the VIX steady near 16.0. The advisory complex — which slid three sessions into month-end — rallied hard: Goldman +2.8%, JPMorgan +1.8%, Lazard +2.0%, Jefferies +1.8%, Morgan Stanley +1.4%. A firm tape plus a re-rating in the advisory names lines up with a genuinely deal-dense stretch, from an ~$18.8B cross-border REIT combination to multiple multi-billion signings.
stories.suggested_action: Use the advisory-stock rebound and a heavy signing calendar to reconnect now — reps are busy, and room readiness is the difference between a process that stays on schedule and one that slips.

talking_point.quote: The advisory tape rebounded hard today — Goldman +2.8%, Lazard +2.0% — and the deal calendar backs it up: Prologis and SEGRO agreed an ~$18.8B cross-border REIT combination that alone put six of the Street’s banks on one transaction, on top of multi-billion energy and industrial signings. When one deal spreads across half a dozen advisers, the shared workspace becomes the control layer. How are you thinking about room readiness on your cross-border mandates this quarter?
talking_point.use_with: Real estate, energy, industrials, insurance and M&A coverage teams (esp. JPMorgan, BofA, Citi, Evercore, Morgan Stanley, Goldman)
talking_point.context: Pairs the advisory-stock rebound with a landmark six-adviser cross-border REIT combination — a natural way to open a room-readiness conversation on complex, multi-party deals.
